0.label: Free game in Solitaire
0.desc: With this box checked, a free game will always be offered once players reach a score of 45,000.

1.label: Allow game continue
1.desc: Check this box to allow players to continue a game by adding more credits once time has run out. Only certain games can continue.

2.label: Rental mode
2.desc: With this box checked, players can purchase a block of time to use to play games.

3.label: Psychographic profiles
3.desc: Lets the machine build player-preference ("psychographic") profiles. A toggle on System Options page 4; what it collects was not traced.

4.label: Allow bonus replay
4.desc: A check in this box enables the replay feature for most games.

5.label: Price display: credits or money
5.desc: Choose whether prices are displayed in credits or in currency. Touch "CRED" or "$/¢" to select the display style.

6.label: Sort price descriptions
6.desc: Sorts the price descriptions shown to players. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

7.label: Split-column move in Power Solitaire
7.desc: A check in this box will allow players to move cards from one column to another.

8.label: Erotic games (master switch)
8.desc: With this box checked, erotic games are available. Highlight "TIMER" to set times during which adult-oriented games are available to players. Use + and - to set the time the games will be turned on and off. The time is set using 24-hour "military" time. The factory default settings are set to turn on at 22:00 (10:00 PM) and off at 6:00 (6:00 AM). This option cannot be enabled simultaneously with the 'Enable Kids Club category' option unless you set the timer. With the timer set, the Kids Club category will replace the Erotic category at the indicated time.

9.label: Show correct answer in trivia games
9.desc: Check the box to show the correct answer when the player answers incorrectly.

10.label: Trivia rounds / bonus
10.desc: Select either 4 Trivia Whiz questions per game with a score of 300k needed to get bonus questions or 5 questions per game and a score of 1m needed for bonus questions.

11.label: TournaMAXX allowed in free play
11.desc: Lets TournaMAXX games run while the machine is in free-play mode (checked by the game menu when a game is chosen).

12.label: TournaMAXX price differs from regular price
12.desc: Charges a different price for the TournaMAXX version of a game than for normal play (read by the books' game-cost calculation).
12.crown_note: Jade/Crown: runtime "local tournament in progress" flag.

13.label: Six Stars operator shortcut
13.desc: Check this box to allow access to the following options without opening the game to access the setup button. With 6 Stars enabled, you can access these options by touching the "Options" button on the main menu screen, then touching "6 Stars" and entering your 6-Star PIN.

14.label: Free game in Power Solitaire
14.desc: With this box checked, a free game will always be offered once players reach a score of 55,000.

15.label: Rental mode: 5-row price table
15.desc: Allows five rows in the coinless/rental (CCO) price table instead of the shorter default table.
15.crown_note: Jade/Crown: turns on pay-per-time (coinless coin-op) pricing.

16.label: Touch2Play mode
16.desc: Runs the machine as a Touch2Play product (changes the game menu and high-score screens).

17.label: Women golfers in Golf
17.desc: Check the box to allow players to choose women golfers.

18.label: Photo Hunt hints
18.desc: Select either 3 hints per game or 5 hints per round to be displayed in Photo Hunt.

19.label: Merit Money
19.desc: Check this box to enable the Merit Money feature on this game.

20.label: TournaMAXX
20.desc: Enables TournaMAXX network tournaments (the "On-Line" choice of Select Tournament Mode). On Crown keys this is locked off, which is why TournaMAXX had to be enabled in the key.

21.label: Music timer from Six Stars
21.desc: Check this box to allow access to the TouchTunes Music Timer through 6 stars.

22.label: Player-selectable language
22.desc: Touch this box to allow the player to select a language from the list of languages available. Touch "SET" to select which languages will be displayed for the player to choose. To clear a particular language from the list of choices the player will have, select it and touch "Clear Language."

23.label: Auto-clear high scores
23.desc: Check this box to enable the game to automatically delete the high scores and select the time period for the score to remain on the game (from the time the player name is entered).

24.label: Allow clearing credits
24.desc: Allows the operator to clear the credits on the machine. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

25.label: Moan sounds in Strip Club
25.desc: A check in this box enables moaning sounds while playing Strip Club.

26.label: High scores from Six Stars
26.desc: Check this box to allow clearing of high scores through 6 star access.

27.label: Video billboard from Six Stars
27.desc: Check this box to allow access to the video billboard through 6 stars.

28.label: Volume control from Six Stars
28.desc: Check this box to allow access to the volume control through 6 stars.

29.label: Disable free credits
29.desc: Removes the free-credits function (the coin menus hide it).

30.label: Allow nudity
30.desc: When this box is left unchecked, certain games are disabled and nudity is not allowed. With the box checked, games in the erotic category will show R-rated pictures. With the box unchecked, these games will show G-rated pictures.

31.label: Nudity level
31.desc: Chooses how explicit the erotic games' pictures are.

32.label: Show deck cards
32.desc: Check this box to display the cards before game play begins.

33.label: Checkerz rules
33.desc: Select German or English rules for Checkerz. Kings can move multiple free spaces in German Checkerz.

34.label: Fan time
34.desc: Touch "SHORT" for a brief view of cards or "LONG" for a longer view.

35.label: Language buttons have flags
35.desc: Touch the box to display the language choices on the main menu (accessed through the language capsule icon) as flags in place of words.

36.label: Tournament support (internal)
36.desc: Internal tournament switch written together with TournaMAXX by "Select Tournament Mode". On Crown it gated the Merit-thon / tournament bookkeeping screens.

37.label: Calibration from Six Stars
37.desc: Check this box to allow access to screen calibration through 6 stars.

38.label: Face-up cards in Tri-Towers
38.desc: Checking this box allows players to choose to play with cards face up or face down.

39.label: Strip Club rewinds on loss
39.desc: A losing hand in Strip Club will return the player to the previous picture if this box is checked.

40.label: Kids category
40.desc: Check this box to add a special kids category to the game. To enable both Kids Club and Erotic Games, you must touch 'TIMER' next to the 'Enable erotic games:' option and set the timer for erotic games. With the timer set, the Kids Club category will replace the Erotic category at the indicated time.

41.label: Free play
41.desc: With this box checked, all game play and features are free.

42.label: Easy mode
42.desc: Check the box to reduce the number of points needed to reach the bonus round for Hoop Jones, Eleven-Up, Tri-Towers, Royal Flash, and Quik Match.

43.label: Same category for all in Power Trivia
43.desc: With this option checked, all players must play the same category, as opposed to players selecting individual categories.

44.label: Consolation question in Power Trivia
44.desc: Check this box to give players an extra question if they incorrectly answer all questions in a game.

45.label: My Merit
45.desc: Check this box to enable the My Merit feature on this game.

46.label: Continuous bonus round
46.desc: Check this box to enable players to continue to earn bonus rounds if they continue to clear the playing field (Tri-Towers, 11-Up, Quik Match, Tri-Castle, and 11-Ball only).

47.label: Senior mode
47.desc: Turns on Senior Mode: games that support it play more slowly, and the books and menus treat the machine as a senior venue.
47.crown_note: Jade/Crown: read only by a special screen/demo mode that forces game bits.

48.label: Theft deterrent
48.desc: Touch the box to turn on theft deterrent. You will be prompted to enter a PIN(4-8 digits), then to enter the theft deterrent time interval. With this option selected, the game will automatically shut down at this interval and can only be reactivated by entering the PIN. To avoid system shutdown, the theft deterrent must be turned off and turned back on again before the end of the interval is reached.

49.label: Lease mode (time bomb)
49.desc: Puts the machine on a lease: it stops working after a set period unless the lease is renewed.

50.label: TournaMAXX update from Six Stars
50.desc: Check this box to allow access to perform a TournaMAXX update through 6 stars.

51.label: Promo credits
51.desc: Check this box to enable the Promo Credits feature on this game.

52.label: Linked games (Mega-Link)
52.desc: A check in this box displays the Mega-Link icon in the game menu and allows players to challenge each other from game to game. You must have your games linked using Mega-Link in order for this to function.

53.label: No names in high scores
53.desc: Check this box to display only scores in the high score list.

54.label: Web filter
54.desc: With this box checked, the basic pornography filter will be turned on.

55.label: High-resolution mode
55.desc: With this box checked, your monitor will switch to a hi resolution mode during web browsing (see MegaWeb) and is necessary for TouchTunes remote SETUP access.

56.label: MegaWeb browser
56.desc: With this box checked, the Merit web browser will be available to players via the GTNet menu.

57.label: Prize Zone
57.desc: Touch this box to enable the Prize Zone game category within the MegaNet menu. Prize Zone lets players play certain Megatouch games, earn Prize Bucks and shop for prizes right from the game. Prizes will be mailed to address provided by player.

58.label: Premium erotic (Penthouse)
58.desc: Touch this box to enable Penthouse within the Meganet menu. Penthouse offers adult-oriented premium priced games with sexy Penthouse photo content. This option cannot be used with the 'Enable kids category' option.

59.label: Entertainment Channel
59.desc: Touch this box to enable the Entertainment Channel within the MegaNet menu. Premium priced, The Entertainment Channel offers players a daily dose of horoscopes and comics plus celebrity trivia, birthdays and quotes.

60.label: Educational attract mode
60.desc: With this box checked, instructional screens will be displayed throughout the idle mode to inform the player on how to use the machine.

61.label: Coinless coin-op
61.desc: With this box checked, games can be played without depositing money. Players pay when they are done playing.

62.label: Hot Topics (downloadable content)
62.desc: Touch this box to enable the Hot Topics game category within the GTNet menu. The two Hot Topics games, Quiz Show and Mystery Phraze, offer players current events content.

63.label: Quick pricing
63.desc: Offers the Quick Price Setup screens in the coin menu (set the credit value, credits per game and display style in four steps).

64.label: Premium erotic ads in idle
64.desc: Enabling this will enable Premium Erotic ad screens if Premium Erotic is enabled.

65.label: Attract mode sounds
65.desc: With this box checked, audio is enabled for custom movies in the attract mode. This setting has no effect on the standard idle mode, which is always silent.

66.label: Operator website
66.desc: Turns on the operator's own website feature in the network menu.

67.label: MindSpark mode
67.desc: Runs the machine as a MindSpark-branded product (the platform check reads it).

68.label: ShowTenders (old switch)
68.desc: With this box checked, ShowTenders will be available from the Six Stars menu.

69.label: Auto-continue
69.desc: Check this box to allow players to select the Auto-Continue mode which will automatically continue for them within a game.

70.label: Card back advertising
70.desc: Enabling this will allow games with ad support to display them during gameplay. Ads will replace the games regular card back graphic.

71.label: Premiere tournament terminal
71.desc: Makes the machine a Premiere tournament terminal (changes the menu layout and the AMI link).
71.crown_note: Jade 2/Crown: hides the TournaMAXX ranking/events screens.

73.label: Player key (Megatouch Nation)
73.desc: With this box checked, Megatouch Nation will be available after touching a Player Key

74.label: Bowling Poker
74.desc: Enables the Bowling Poker game. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

75.label: Force slow senior game play
75.desc: Enabling this will force the games that play differently to do so even when Senior Mode is not enabled.

76.label: High resolution for TouchTunes
76.desc: Switches to high resolution for TouchTunes remote setup.

77.label: Erotic games in attract mode
77.desc: Shows erotic games in the attract mode. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

78.label: Erotic games in New Games
78.desc: Lists erotic games in the New Games category. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

79.label: Erotic games into New Games automatically
79.desc: Places new erotic games in the New Games category automatically. No code in the scanned builds reads it.

80.label: Network options from Six Stars
80.desc: Allows the network options through Six Stars. No code in the scanned builds reads it (slot 0x76 is the one the menus use).

82.desc: Check this box to allow access to Operator Setup Menu through 6 stars.

83.label: Unlock Firefly from Six Stars

84.desc: Lets players unlock a Firefly machine themselves.

85.label: Prize pools on main menu
85.desc: With this box checked, prize pools for current tournaments will be displayed on the main menu.

90.desc: Check this box to allow access to Free Credits Menu through 6 stars.
